items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Steps Up Legal Fight Over Illegal Retatrutide Sales
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) has intensified legal action against U.S. entities accused of selling unauthorized versions of its experimental obesity drug retatrutide. The company is pursuing multiple lawsuits as part of a broader effort to curb black market distribution of the unapproved treatment.
